what: N7: the naming model is set once in Exosurface's configuration and shared by every profile, not in a profile's configuration the way the compactor is; per-profile naming model choice is dropped.
why: Pinned OptChat keeps only the keys it knows in a profile config, so a naming model set there is dropped on the next OptChat settings save and the configured model silently reverts to the default, breaking the owner ruling never to substitute a model silently. Decided by the owner (Tom, 2026-11-04 19:58 MST), approved as the final design (one profile maps to one surface); the owner's own amendment PR #93 (0d02d99, Accept hmw2yorzntyep) carries the N7 text, so this lane's branch holds main's spec unchanged.
evidence: OptChat aae1caf src/profiles.ts:51-55 loadConfig returns only compactor, subagent and the typed SETTINGS keys (settings.ts), dropping 'namer'; src/settings-page.ts:117-120 saves that filtered config via src/index.ts:524-526 and profiles.ts:46 saveConfig.
